result: Three PR519 review findings are addressed on an exact green SHA: no reusable launch secret is emitted to public assets, independent rooms persist together across restart, and the production HTTPS regression runs permanently with negative secret and multi-room assertions.

evidence: HEXCRAWL_VTT_PREVIEW_KEY removed from production configuration and App launch request
Room creation is constrained by exact editor Origin and bounded room capacity
Bounded in-memory registry keyed by independent master authorities
Version-2 durable registry stores multiple rooms while reading legacy version 1
CI result isolatedRooms=true; both rooms and player links restore after restart
Per-tab sessionStorage prevents master tabs from overwriting room authority
Production HTTPS step and artifact upload no longer depend on PR number 519
Existing production scenario asserts forbidden secret sentinel absent from dist
Existing VTT room scenario asserts launch request sends no reusable bearer

ci.infrastructure_note: The first world-random attempt stopped before tests because the runner's apt repositories lacked Playwright font packages; rerunning that job installed Chromium and passed the RNG suite.

test_change_summary.scenario_risk: Reusable public-bundle authority, cross-room state/credential collision, durable restore of multiple rooms, and loss of the production regression outside PR519.
test_change_summary.reuse_or_new_reason: Extended the two existing VTT scenarios instead of adding a duplicate suite: production HTTPS now asserts a secret-free bundle and two isolated durable rooms; the local room scenario asserts no launch bearer and per-tab master authority.

limitations: The verified HTTPS environment is ephemeral and not an owner-accessible durable/public stand.
No publication or merge to main was authorized or performed.
The normal Pages build remains VTT-disabled when no room-service URL is configured.
next_step: Independently review exact SHA 7f602111fcce88b8e2d157baa252b32f3954eae1 against F519-SEC-001, F519-DEPLOY-002 and F519-TEST-003, re-inspect the artifact and refresh the acceptance verdict and 1.3-rc8 score assessment.
